The day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks). For 
Air Groove, it was a momentous race where 
winning would mean a mother-daughter sweep 
across two generations.

Expressing a desire to understand what her 
mother felt when approaching this race, 
she—

To catch up to her "ideal," she strode 
toward the battlefield, more focused than 
ever before.
